opening_question_spark: If everyone vanished tomorrow, what would happen first while your garden hose kept running?
entry_transition: That question flows straight into the crone's waiting orb.
cta: Like and subscribe to grow more questions.
body: Within hours, unattended power grids would begin failing.
Many lights would go dark across cities.
Some nuclear plants would shut down automatically.
Others would need cooling to keep working.
Pets trapped indoors would face danger quickly.
Farm animals would break loose or starve.
Within days, subways could flood without pumps.
Within weeks, vegetation would reclaim roads.
Years later, roofs would leak and buildings crumble.
Wildlife would spread through emptied neighborhoods.
optional_closing: Earth would not stop without us; our systems would.
full_narration: If everyone vanished tomorrow, what would happen first while your garden hose kept running? That question flows straight into the crone's waiting orb. Within hours, unattended power grids would begin failing. Many lights would go dark across cities. Some nuclear plants would shut down automatically. Others would need cooling to keep working. Pets trapped indoors would face danger quickly. Farm animals would break loose or starve. Within days, subways could flood without pumps. Within weeks, vegetation would reclaim roads. Years later, roofs would leak and buildings crumble. Wildlife would spread through emptied neighborhoods. Earth would not stop without us; our systems would.
